description: Hardware identity of the AEFI device: source geometry, excitation electronics, sensor, conditioning electronics

sphere_labels._note: Quadrant convention (2026-07-24, corrects the earlier x+/x-/y+/y- half-axis labeling). S_i occupies a quadrant, not a half-axis. Source of truth: 'ImagerieElectrique - Correspondance Poupette Sortie DDS - Connexion Carte Amplification Excitation' and the 'NOTE - Source Frame Geometry' (Luis Saluden's vault, not tracked in this repo).

sphere_diameters._note: Diameter phi_i (m) per sphere, measured individually at the caliper 2026-07-24 (mesures-dgp-pied-a-coulisse-4spheres). Sphere centers are not physically accessible to the caliper, so this and pairwise_distances_ext below are what's actually measured; center-to-center distances (r_i = phi_i/2, d_ij = D_ij - r_i - r_j) are derived in code, not stored here. uncertainty.expanded = U = k*u_c (GUM) for a single reading at the instrument resolution (0.02mm vernier, u_c = res/(2*sqrt(3))).

pairwise_distances_ext._note: 6 extremity-to-extremity distances D_ij (m), measured at the caliper 2026-07-24 (mesures-dgp-pied-a-coulisse-4spheres): the caliper spans the outer extremities of the two spheres, i.e. D_ij = center-to-center + r_i + r_j. Center-to-center distance is derived in code as d_ij = D_ij - r_i - r_j, not stored here. uncertainty.expanded as above (single caliper reading, 0.02mm vernier resolution).

dimension.description: Characteristic size of the sensor cube

z_offset.description: Z distance from the source plane to the center of the sensor
